select count(*) from flights
and user_id = #{userId}

select coalesce(sum(it.total_detections), 0) from inference_tasks it left join flights f on it.flight_id = f.id
it.status = 1 and (f.user_id = #{userId} or it.flight_id is null)

select coalesce(sum(duration), 0) from flights
and user_id = #{userId}

select count(distinct d.sn) from devices d
and d.user_id = #{userId}

select
DATE_FORMAT(it.start_time, '%H:%i') as date, DATE_FORMAT(it.start_time, '%m-%d %H:00') as date, DATE_FORMAT(it.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date,
coalesce(sum(it.total_detections), 0) as detections from inference_tasks it left join flights f on it.flight_id = f.id
it.status = 1
and it.start_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 1 hour) and it.start_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 1 day) and it.start_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 day) and it.start_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 30 day)
and (f.user_id = #{userId} or it.flight_id is null)
group by date order by date asc

select
DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%H:%i') as date, DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%m-%d %H:00') as date, DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date,
count(*) as count from flights
start_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 1 hour) start_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 1 day) start_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 day) start_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 30 day)
and user_id = #{userId}
group by date order by date asc

select it.id, it.result_data as resultData from inference_tasks it left join flights f on it.flight_id = f.id
it.status = 1 and it.result_data is not null and it.result_data != '' and (f.user_id = #{userId} or it.flight_id is null)

select u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, count(f.id) as flightCount from users u left join flights f on u.user_id = f.user_id group by u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name order by flightCount desc limit 10
